# Introduction

This document includes updates from both the main branch and testbranch. I manually resolved the merge conflict by combining the changes into one final version.

## About this file

This file is used to show that I can create and render a basic Quarto document.

## Simple calculation

```{r}
2 + 2
```

## Simple Plot

The plot below shows a simple relationship between two variables.

```{r}
x <- 1:5
y <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)

plot(x, y,
     main = "Simple Plot",
     xlab = "X values",
     ylab = "Y values")

```
